title: Pivot
brief: You cannot reach the database from your laptop, but the web server can. Log in to web and look for how its admin works.
hint.1: notes.txt has a login for web. ssh webadmin@web.
hint.2: Shell history files are hidden: ls -a, then cat .bash_history.
hint.3: The history leaks the db login. ssh dba@db, then cat flag.txt.
walkthrough: Log in to web, read .bash_history, log in to db with dba, read flag.txt.
debrief: Attackers move from one machine to the next (pivoting), using credentials they find on the way. Shell history is a favourite source. Defenders: segment networks, never type passwords in commands, and clear or disable sensitive history.
objective.db: Hop from web to the database host
